name: FII Factory REST Bridge
description: Read-only MCP tools for the FII factory backend REST API. This server never connects directly to the factory database.

tools.name: mkz_get_machines
tools.description: Get machines from the FII backend

tools.name: mkz_get_production_lines
tools.description: Get production lines from the FII backend

tools.name: mkz_get_alarms
tools.description: Get alarm records from the FII backend

tools.name: mkz_get_dashboard_summary
tools.description: Get dashboard KPIs and machine/alarm totals

tools.name: mkz_get_production_report
tools.description: Get production report data by time range, line, or machine

tools.name: mkz_get_telemetry
tools.description: Get live or recent telemetry from the FII backend

setup_instructions: 1. Start the FII .NET backend at http://127.0.0.1:5165.

2. Create a service account + long-lived API key (ADMIN only): POST http://127.0.0.1:5165/api/users/service-account with JSON body {"username":"odysseus-service","role":"ENGINEER"} and an admin JWT. The response returns apiKey (fii_sk_...) once.

3. Export the key in the Odysseus process environment: MKZ_BACKEND_API_KEY=fii_sk_... (preferred, long-lived). For loopback-only JWT access set MKZ_BACKEND_TOKEN instead. This template inherits these from the parent environment.
4. Add this command and environment configuration in Odysseus Settings > MCP Servers.
5. Save and reconnect the MCP server.
